field_edits.updated_text: Prominence and tortuosity of the thoracic aortic contour, likely reflecting age-related aortic unfolding/ectasia. The cardiomediastinal silhouette is within normal limits. No mediastinal widening or hilar enlargement.

impression:
1. Prominent/tortuous thoracic aortic contour, likely chronic aortic ectasia/unfolding. If clinically indicated, correlation with prior imaging or cross-sectional imaging may be considered to exclude significant aortic dilatation.
2. No acute abnormality.
